one_line_description.value: Salesforce is an AI CRM platform.

has_public_api.quote: For a client application to access REST API resources, it must be authorized as a safe visitor.

api_type.quote: To successfully send requests, REST API requires an access token obtained by authentication.

api_breadth.value: Read-write SObject record operations (create, read, update, delete).
api_breadth.quote: SObject Operations: Read, create, update, and delete Salesforce records with tools that respect field-level security and sharing rules

docs_url.quote: Explore developer guides and reference docs for Salesforce APIs.

auth_methods.quote: For an external client app or connected app to request access, it must be integrated with your org’s REST API using the OAuth 2.0 protocol.

access_model.quote: Complete these steps in your Developer Edition org or development sandbox.

access_notes.value: Developer Edition or sandbox for development; production API access depends on an API-enabled edition/license and purchased API Call Add-Ons. Hosted MCP endpoint is configured per org and requires Flex Credits.
access_notes.quote: Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers are intended only for customers with Flex Credits and you may be billed for server usage.

official_mcp_server.quote: Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers give AI agents a secure, governed way to interact with Salesforce data and automation.

rate_limits.value: Developer Edition: 15,000 API calls per 24-hour period.

webhooks.quote: Supply an HTTPS callback URL, also known as a webhook, for your application.

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: Complete these steps in your Developer Edition org or development sandbox.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Versioned REST endpoints (for example, /services/data/v68.0/); deprecation/sunset policy not found in fetched sources.

verdict_reason: Salesforce publishes official REST API documentation, OAuth 2.0 authentication, and a Developer Edition/sandbox development route with documented API allocations. The API supports read-write SObject operations, and Hosted MCP servers are also documented. Production licensing and MCP Flex Credits are commercial gates, not barriers to self-serve development.
